SELECT c.id, c.category_name, c.sort, c.created_time, c.updated_time, c.deleted AS deleted_flag, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scale s WHERE s.scale_category_id = c.id AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 AND s.current_version_id IS NOT NULL) AS scale_count FROM scale_category c
AND c.category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{categoryName}, '%')
AND c.deleted = #{deletedFlag}
ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
